Launch the Habit Designer ↗Browse the Habit Menu

Build a habit: B = MAP

The Behavior Design Model, developed by BJ Fogg, simplifies behavior change into a formula: B = MAP, where B is Behavior, M is Motivation, A is Ability, and P is Prompt. Behavior happens when all three converge.

Break a habit: B = M − A − P

To stop an unwanted behavior, reverse the formula: make the motivation, the ability, and the prompt harder to act on. Making all three difficult can effectively disrupt the behavior.
